verdict.rationale: Readable German text was extracted from the front pages of both unternehmensregister.de and handelsregister.de, including service descriptions, guidance pointers and status notices. That implies the public reading surface returns server-rendered content to a fetcher rather than a JS-only shell or a challenge page. However, no probe explicitly records a keyless fetch with an identified user agent, the absence of a CAPTCHA, or access to deeper guidance pages. The published overload notices also show availability can lapse under high retrieval volume, and the only explicit probe (llms.txt 404) concerns an agent docs index rather than reachability itself. Missing for 10: an explicit hands-on fetch confirming no bot wall or CAPTCHA under an identified UA, evidence that deeper guidance pages (e.g. Bilanz-Navigator, help pages) are reachable without JS, and independent corroboration.
